slides.label: THE WINDOW
head: MAY 1
TO JUNE 5.
slides.example: Idaho controlled hunt applications. These are 2026 dates; 2027 isn't posted yet.

slides.label: THE RESULTS
head: MID-JUNE.
slides.example: First draw results posted June 17 in 2026. Leftover tags go to a second draw in August.

slides.label: THE EMAIL
head: TAG DEADLINE
IS JUNE 5.
slides.example: “Hi [first name], quick heads up: the Idaho elk application window closes June 5. If you draw, I'm holding [dates] for you. If you don't, let me know and we'll figure out next year.”

slides.label: WHEN TO SEND IT
head: 2 TO 3 WEEKS
BEFORE JUNE 5.
slides.example: Then email again when results post. That's when a hunter who drew is ready to book.

slides.body: and I'll send you the template.
